name: Tackle
description: A full-body charge attack.

name: Scratch
description: Scratches with sharp claws.

name: Thunder Shock
description: An electric attack that may cause paralysis.

name: Growl
description: Lowers the foe's Attack.

name: Tail Whip
description: Lowers the foe's Defense.

name: Vine Whip
description: Strikes the foe with slender vines.

name: Razor Leaf
description: Sharp leaves slash the foe. High critical-hit ratio.

name: Ember
description: A weak fire attack that may cause a burn.

name: Flamethrower
description: A powerful fire attack that may cause a burn.

name: Water Gun
description: Squirts water to attack the foe.

name: Bubble Beam
description: A spray of bubbles that may lower the foe's Speed.

name: Quick Attack
description: An extremely fast attack that always strikes first.

name: Thunderbolt
description: A strong electric attack that may cause paralysis.

name: Bite
description: Bites with sharp fangs. May cause flinching.

name: Swift
description: Star-shaped rays that never miss.

name: Leer
description: Frightens the foe with a harsh glare, lowering Defense.

name: Howl
description: A howl that raises the Attack stat.

name: Astonish
description: An attack that may cause flinching.

name: Shadow Sneak
description: The user extends its shadow and attacks the foe from behind.

name: Hex
description: Innately sinister curses strike foes down with unusual power.

name: Ice Shard
description: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them.

name: Ice Fang
description: The user bites with coldly sharp fangs. May lower Defense.

name: Icy Wind
description: A chilling wind lowers the foe's Speed.

name: Dark Pulse
description: A horrible aura radiates from the user. May cause flinching.

name: Crunch
description: The user chomps hard on the foe. May lower Defense.

name: Feint Attack
description: The user approaches the foe with a feint, then slaps it. Never misses.

name: Sucker Punch
description: An attack that strikes first, but only if the foe is readying an attack.

name: Night Shade
description: A vision of the underworld strikes, dealing damage equal to the user's level.

name: Will-O-Wisp
description: A sinister blue-white flame burns the foe, lowering its Attack.

name: Fire Fang
description: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. May burn the foe.

name: Wing Attack
description: Strikes the foe with outspread wings.

name: Peck
description: Jabs the foe with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

name: Super Fang
description: Sharp fangs attack, halving the foe's current HP.

name: Scary Face
description: A frightening visage lowers the foe's Speed sharply.

name: Hone Claws
description: The user sharpens its claws, raising Attack and Accuracy.
